title: The 13 Best Espresso Machines 2026
metaDescription: Our 13 picks for espresso machines 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at espresso machines 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Breville Barista Express BES870XL
products.blurb: Key specs: Built-in conical burr grinder, 15-bar pump, PID temperature control.
strengths: Built-in conical burr grinder removes the need to buy a separate grinder, the one unit that makes espresso genuinely accessible at home
PID temperature control holds brew temperature to within 1 degree, which is the single most important factor in shot consistency
Steam wand produces real microfoam for latte art, not automatic frothing with pre-set temperature
The most commonly recommended all-in-one espresso machine by home baristas and coffee forums
limitations: Built-in grinder cannot be upgraded separately as skills develop
Single boiler means waiting between pulling shots and steaming milk
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Breville Bambino Plus BES500BSS
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-second heat-up, Automatic milk texturing, PID temperature.
strengths: 3-second heat-up via thermojet heating system, the fastest heat-up of any pump espresso machine
Automatic milk texturing produces consistent microfoam without manual wand technique
Compact enough for small kitchen counters where a larger machine won't fit
limitations: Requires a separate grinder, does not include built-in grinding
Auto milk texturing is not adjustable for different milk temperatures

products.name: Gaggia Classic Pro
products.blurb: Key specs: Commercial-grade group head, 58mm portafilter, Steam wand.
strengths: Commercial-grade group head and 58mm portafilter, the same standard used in professional espresso bars
Made in Italy by one of the oldest espresso machine manufacturers
The most moddable beginner machine, widely supported by the home espresso modification community
Produces genuinely good espresso when paired with a quality grinder
limitations: No PID in the stock configuration, temperature surfing is required for consistent shots
Pairing with a quality grinder is mandatory, not optional
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: De'Longhi Dedica Arte EC885M
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-inch wide body, Manual frother, 15-bar pump.
strengths: 6-inch wide body is the narrowest pump espresso machine that produces acceptable shots
Manual panarello frother, upgradeable to a proper steam tip for real microfoam
15-bar pump delivers adequate pressure for espresso
The correct machine for extremely small kitchens where a standard machine will not fit
limitations: Proprietary 51mm portafilter limits aftermarket basket options
No PID, temperature consistency is inferior to machines with proper controls

products.name: Jura E8 Chrome Automatic Espresso Machine
products.blurb: Key specs: Fully automatic, Built-in grinder, One-touch drinks.
strengths: One-touch operation for espresso, lungo, flat white, and cappuccino, no barista skills required
Built-in conical burr grinder with 10 grind settings directly in the machine
CLARIS water filter reduces limescale buildup, which is the primary failure point of super-automatics
The most reliable super-automatic brand in the category, Jura machines last longer than competitors
limitations: Very high price compared to semi-automatic alternatives
Less espresso quality ceiling than a well-dialed semi-automatic

products.name: Rancilio Silvia Espresso Machine
products.blurb: Key specs: Commercial group head, Steel construction, 58mm portafilter.
strengths: The Silvia uses the same commercial group head and portafilter as professional espresso bars
Heavy steel construction, built to the same durability standard as commercial machines
3-way solenoid valve prevents post-shot dripping and keeps the puck dry
The most repairable home espresso machine, parts are available worldwide
limitations: No PID in standard configuration, PID modification is strongly recommended
Single boiler requires a wait between pulling and steaming

products.name: Breville Oracle Touch BES990BSS
products.blurb: Key specs: Dual boiler, Automatic grinding and tamping, Touch screen.
strengths: Dual boiler allows simultaneous brewing and steaming with no wait between operations
Automatic grinding, dosing, and tamping removes the three most skill-dependent steps
Touch screen with drink presets that save and repeat extraction parameters
The highest-ceiling machine with the lowest skill floor in the category
limitations: Automatic tamping is not as adjustable as manual tamping for specialty extraction
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Breville Dual Boiler BES920XL
products.blurb: Key specs: Dual stainless steel boilers, PID temperature control, Simultaneous brew and steam.
strengths: Dual stainless steel boilers allow simultaneous brewing and steaming with no wait between operations
PID-controlled brew and steam temperatures maintain independent, precise settings
Commercial-grade build quality, the correct machine for a permanent home setup
The most capable prosumer machine from a mainstream, widely-serviced brand
limitations: Requires a high-end grinder to realize its ceiling

products.name: Nespresso Vertuo Next Coffee and Espresso Machine
products.blurb: Key specs: Vertuo pod system, Centrifusion extraction, Multiple cup sizes.
strengths: Pod system requires zero technique, the only espresso-adjacent machine with no skill floor
Centrifusion extraction produces a consistent result from every pod
Multiple cup sizes from espresso to large coffee from the same machine
The correct choice for households where convenience is the absolute priority
limitations: Proprietary pod system, locked to Nespresso pods at a per-cup premium
Centrifusion extraction is not equivalent to 9-bar pump espresso

products.name: De'Longhi Dinamica Plus ECAM370.95.T
products.blurb: Key specs: Fully automatic, LatteCrema system, Color touch display.
strengths: De'Longhi LatteCrema system automatically froths and dispenses milk directly into the cup
Bean-to-cup operation with adjustable grind size and strength settings
Color touch display with drink presets and My Menu customization
The correct super-automatic at a lower price than Jura for comparable functionality
limitations: LatteCrema system requires regular cleaning to prevent milk residue buildup
Espresso quality ceiling is lower than a well-tuned semi-automatic

products.name: Baratza Encore ESP Conical Burr Grinder
products.blurb: Key specs: Conical burr, Espresso-capable grind range, 40mm burr set.
strengths: The Encore ESP is purpose-built for espresso, its predecessor the Encore could not reach espresso-fine grinds
40mm conical burr set produces consistent particle size at espresso settings
Baratza provides replacement parts and repair support, the most serviced grinder brand
The correct entry-level espresso grinder to pair with a Breville Bambino Plus or Gaggia Classic Pro
limitations: Single-dose grinding is not as clean as stepless grinders at the same price
Not suitable for filter coffee at the finest end of its range

products.name: Baratza Sette 270Wi Conical Burr Grinder
products.blurb: Key specs: Conical burr, Grind-by-weight, Espresso-specific.
strengths: Grind-by-weight scale allows dialing in espresso doses to a precision that volumetric grinders cannot
Purpose-built espresso grind range with fast, direct-drop dosing straight into the portafilter
Baratza's repair support and parts availability reduce anti-static clumping and retention issues over time
limitations: Grind-by-weight interface has a steeper learning curve than simple stepped grinders for beginners
Not as quiet as some alternatives
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Gaggia Classic Evo Pro Espresso Machine
strengths: Commercial 58mm portafilter
Powerful commercial steam wand
Simple, repairable design
Large enthusiast community and parts
limitations: No PID temperature control as standard
Steep learning curve
Needs a capable separate grinder

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
